title: Voyeurism
plain_summary: Addresses watching, capturing or disseminating images of a woman's private act under specified conditions.
explanations: Private-act images may be relevant; consent and the statutory conditions need review.

title: Stalking
plain_summary: Covers specified repeated unwanted contact or monitoring of a woman's electronic communications, subject to exceptions.
explanations: Repeated contact or monitoring may warrant examination under this provision.

title: Insulting modesty or intruding on privacy
plain_summary: Addresses specified words, gestures or acts intended to insult a woman's modesty, including privacy intrusion.
explanations: The words, intent and privacy intrusion require factual assessment.

title: Criminal intimidation
plain_summary: Addresses threats intended to cause alarm or compel conduct, including threats to reputation.
explanations: Threats or blackmail may be relevant; intent and context must be assessed.

title: Defamation
plain_summary: Addresses reputation-harming imputations, with statutory exceptions.
explanations: False published claims may warrant review; exceptions matter.

title: Identity theft
plain_summary: Addresses dishonest or fraudulent use of another's password, electronic signature or unique identification feature.

title: Cheating by online personation
plain_summary: Addresses cheating by personation using a computer resource or communication device.
explanations: A fake profile alone does not establish cheating.

title: Violation of privacy
plain_summary: Addresses nonconsensual capture, publication or transmission of private-area images under specified circumstances.
explanations: Image content and consent require assessment.

title: Obscene electronic material
plain_summary: Addresses publishing or transmitting legally obscene electronic material.
explanations: The legal obscenity threshold needs examination.

title: Sexually explicit electronic material
plain_summary: Addresses electronic publication or transmission of sexually explicit acts or conduct.
explanations: Actual content and transmission require review.

title: Electronic sexual exploitation of children
plain_summary: Addresses specified electronic sexual-exploitation material and conduct involving children.
explanations: Child-related sexual material needs specialist assessment.

title: Preservation by intermediaries
plain_summary: Addresses intermediaries' prescribed preservation and retention obligations.
explanations: A preservation request may assist; requirements need verification.

title: Electronic evidence certificate
plain_summary: Sets conditions for electronic-record admissibility and a certificate with party and expert portions in the Schedule.
explanations: A hash inventory can support preparation. It does not itself satisfy all certificate or admissibility requirements.

act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
title: Sexual harassment of a child
plain_summary: Defines specified conduct done with sexual intent involving a child.
explanations: Sexual messages or repeated contact involving a minor may be relevant.

act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
title: Punishment for child sexual harassment
plain_summary: Provides punishment for sexual harassment defined in section 11.
explanations: Review alongside section 11 after assessing sexual intent.

act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
title: Use of a child for pornographic purposes
plain_summary: Addresses using a child in media for sexual gratification in specified ways.
explanations: Sexual images involving a child need specialist review.

act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
title: Storage of child sexual material
plain_summary: Addresses possession or storage with specified intent or failures concerning child sexual material.
explanations: Seek specialist help on preservation without redistributing material.

act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
title: Reporting offences
plain_summary: Provides reporting duties and procedures for known or apprehended POCSO offences.
explanations: Police or the Special Juvenile Police Unit can receive reports.
